help.current: It runs the newest agent release.
help.updating: It started on the new version and has five minutes to reach Floorbit; otherwise it goes back to the one before.
help.installing: Floorbit offers {{v}}. The agent installs it within a minute and starts again; in an HA group one agent at a time, the primary last.
help.approve: {{v}} waits for the crew to approve it on the agent (FLOORBIT_AGENT_UPDATES=approve):
help.off: Updates are off on this agent (FLOORBIT_AGENT_UPDATES=off). Pull the new image to update it.
help.image: {{v}} needs a newer image than this agent runs (other packages or Telegraf). Pull it and start the agent again:
help.pull: This agent can't update itself yet. Pull the new image and start it again:
help.floorbit: {{v}} needs a newer Floorbit than this one. It is offered once Floorbit is updated.
help.refused: The agent refused {{v}}. It tries again with the next release.
help.rolled_back: {{v}} didn't reach Floorbit after the update, so the agent went back and won't try it again. `python -m floorbit_agent_boot update retry` on the agent allows it again.
help.none: Floorbit looks for a new agent release every hour.

policy.approve: Waits for approval on the agent
